simpledes: Pre-tax national income is the sum of all pre-tax personal income flows.
technicaldes: Pre-tax national income =Pre-tax labor income+Pre-tax capital income
longpop: The base unit is the individual but resources are split equally within couples.
longage: The population is comprised of individuals over age 20.
method: Summary of data construction by year (see source for details): 1980: extrapolated distribution, 1981-1983: survey + concept correction + tax data, 1984: interpolated survey + concept correction + interpolated tax data, 1985: survey + concept correction + interpolated tax data, 1986-2023: extrapolated distribution using survey data. Before 1980, series is constructed based on the trend observed in the fiscal income data available (see sources). Before 1886, pretax income shares estimated based on methodology in long-run paper (see sources).
